workItems.reason: Microsoft's current Foundry documentation describes Microsoft Foundry as the unified Azure AI platform and maps Azure AI Studio / Azure AI Foundry to Microsoft Foundry.

proposals.sourceQuote: Microsoft Foundry is a unified Azure platform
proposals.rationale: Microsoft describes Microsoft Foundry as the unified Azure AI platform and the current resource model for agents, models, and tools. The provider service label now names Microsoft Foundry Models while retaining Azure OpenAI for continuity.

The current primary documentation for the unified Azure AI platform is the Microsoft Foundry overview. The older Azure OpenAI page is no longer the best primary link for this composite foundation-model row.

proposals.sourceQuote: Azure AI Studio / Azure AI Foundry
proposals.rationale: Microsoft's Evolution of Foundry table maps the prior brand names Azure AI Studio and Azure AI Foundry to the current Microsoft Foundry brand.
